  "description": "Tokiye Integrated Medical Service was created to address the critical needs in healthcare project management with an emphasis on effective and efficient service delivery. The company is driven by a passion for excellence and a commitment to professional service, aiming to elevate Nigeria&rsquo;s healthcare system to international standards.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Sales and Marketing Officer
Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	To drive patient acquisition, corporate partnerships, referral relationships and brand visibility for the hospital through effective digital marketing, &nbsp;business development and relationship management.
	The role requires a commercially minded professional who can grow the hospital&#39;s online presence while building strong relationships with corporate organizations, HMOs, clinics and other healthcare partners to increase patient visits and revenue.


Key Responsibilities
Corporate Sales and Business Development:


	Identify and approach companies, government agencies, schools, organisations and other potential corporate clients.
	Develop relationships with corporate HR teams, administrative managers and decision-makers to promote corporate health checks, medical screenings and employee healthcare services.
	Conduct cold outreach, business visits, presentations and follow-ups to generate new business.
	Prepare proposals, service presentations and quotations for corporate clients.
	Maintain a pipeline of prospects and convert leads into active corporate accounts.


HMO and Healthcare Partnerships:


	Support the development and management of relationships with HMOs, clinics, laboratories, pharmacies and other healthcare partners.
	Assist with HMO panel applications, onboarding documentation and follow-up processes.
	Develop referral relationships that support appropriate patient referrals and increase awareness of the hospital&#39;s specialist services.
	Support the implementation of patient referral, loyalty and corporate wellness programs where applicable.


Marketing Analytics and Reporting:


	Maintain weekly trackers for leads, enquiries, corporate visits, proposals, conversions and revenue generated.
	Prepare weekly performance reports against agreed sales and marketing KPIs.
	Monitor competitor activities, market trends and opportunities for service promotion.
	Recommend practical improvements based on campaign performance, customer feedback and sales results.


Digital Marketing and Brand Management:


	Manage the hospital&#39;s social media platforms, including Instagram and other relevant digital channels.
	Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns to promote hospital services, specialist clinics, health packages and screening programs.
	Manage WhatsApp Business communications and Google Business Profile to improve visibility, enquiries and patient engagement.
	Track campaign performance, audience engagement, leads and conversions, and recommend improvements.
	Coordinate the development of marketing content, flyers and promotional materials using Canva or similar tools.


Stakeholder and Patient Engagement:


	Respond professionally to marketing enquiries and direct prospective patients to the appropriate hospital channels.
	Coordinate with clinical, administrative and customer service teams to ensure accurate communication of hospital services.
	Maintain professional relationships with clients and partners while protecting patient confidentiality.
	Ensure marketing activities comply with hospital policies and applicable healthcare advertising and data protection requirements.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Growth in qualified digital enquiries and patient leads.
	Social media growth, engagement and campaign conversion.
	Number of corporate prospects contacted and meetings conducted.
	Number of corporate accounts and partnerships secured.
	Number of HMO applications or partnership processes progressed.
	Conversion of enquiries and proposals into business.
	Revenue generated from corporate accounts and marketing campaigns.
	Timely submission and accuracy of performance reports.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Public Relations or a related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of relevant marketing or business development experience, preferably in healthcare, wellness or B2B services.
	Demonstrated ability to manage and grow social media accounts with measurable results.
	Experience in corporate sales, cold outreach, presentations and relationship management.
	Proficiency in WhatsApp Business, Instagram, Google Business Profile and Microsoft Excel.
	Ability to create basic marketing designs using Canva or similar tools.
	Demonstrated ability to maintain sales trackers and report performance against weekly KPIs.
	Existing relationships with corporate HR contacts, benefits managers or clinic procurement leads in Abuja and the surrounding business market is a strong advantage
	Familiarity with HMO panel application and onboarding processes, including NHIA, Hygeia and AXA Mansard etc. is highly desired.
	Experience managing healthcare referral programs, patient loyalty initiatives or corporate wellness campaigns.
	Experience marketing specialist consultations, diagnostic services, medical screenings or other hospital services.


Key Competencies:


	Digital marketing and social media management
	B2B sales and corporate relationship management
	Lead generation, prospecting and conversion
	Presentation, negotiation and communication
	Data analysis, KPI tracking and reporting
	Canva and basic content creation skill
	Initiative, organisation and follow-through
	Professionalism, confidentiality and customer focus


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV and Cover letter to: practicemanager@everethereal.com and copy 234ethereal@gmail.com using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Product Manager Job at Duplo




        
    

        
        Duplo is a Lagos-based fintech startup that enables businesses in Africa to automate their spend management, simplify cross-border payments, and control business finances all on one platform.

We want to make B2B payments as simple as P2P payment apps. Most business payments in Africa are made offline…yikes. We are on a mission to transform this. We are backed by top investors, including Tribe Capital, Commerce Ventures, Liquid2 Ventures, My Asia VC, Soma Capital, Y Combinator, Oui Capital, and others.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Product Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work mode: Hybrid
Department: Product
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Description


	This is a unique opportunity. You'll own the strategy and roadmap for Duplo Dashboard, the spend management and billing platform businesses across Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana and Kenya rely on, to control company spend and get paid.


Responsibilities


	Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for Duplo Dashboard (Spend Management, Billing, and Compartmentalisation, TMS, E-invoicing), aligned with Duplo's broader platform strategy.
	Lead end-to-end delivery of the Billing and Compartmentalisation monetisation roadmap, from discovery and BRD/PRD authorship through launch and adoption.
	Partner with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Finance, and GTM to translate customer and business requirements into shippable, well-scoped product increments.
	Define and track success metrics for the Dashboard product line (activation, adoption, revenue impact) and use data to prioritise the roadmap.
	Run customer discovery and stakeholder interviews across Duplo's markets (Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana, Kenya) to validate use cases.
	Own migration planning for existing non-paying customers as monetised billing features roll out, minimising churn and support escalations.
	Write clear, detailed product requirement documents and collaborate with engineering on technical feasibility and sequencing.
	Represent the Dashboard/Spend platform in cross-functional planning, and mentor or support other product managers as needed.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
	5-6 years of product management experience, including experience owning a B2B fintech, payments, or SaaS product from strategy through delivery.
	Demonstrated experience shipping financial operations solutions, monetisation or billing features (subscriptions, invoicing, usage-based billing, or similar) at a fintech or B2B company.
	Strong ability to write clear BRDs/PRDs and work cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Compliance, and GTM to ship complex, regulated products.
	Comfortable working with data to define success metrics, prioritise a roadmap, and make trade-off decisions with limited information.
	Experience or strong interest in African markets and the operational realities of building B2B financial infrastructure across multiple countries.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
	A bias for action and comfort operating in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities.
